Local-first knowledge base made for Typst and the Atmosphere.

Local-first knowledge base made for Typst and the Atmosphere. Pages, plugins, and workspace settings are Typst sources and Loro CRDT documents. Sync, collaboration, publishing, and plugins run over the AT Protocol.
